notes.title: Xenrai Celestial Horizon Update
notes.notes:
We here at Zenith Edge studios want to again thank everyone who has purchased Xenrai in Early Access, and a special thank you to everyone who has sent us feedback, constructive or just to let us know that you are enjoying the game!

Xenrai is fully launching, and with it a new update filled with new levels to explore and new difficult boss encounters!

Deep in the darkness and quietness of the void lies a prison hovering on the edge of a black hole. Within it, lies a Vile like no other!


Features:

[olist]
[*]     New levels and enemy encounters that will test your skills to the limit.
[*]     Performance Improvements
[*]     Bug fixes
[/olist]

notes.title: Planet Zahur Flourishes Update
notes.notes:
We here at Zenith Edge studios want to again thank everyone who has purchased Xenrai in Early Access, and a special thank you to everyone who has sent us feedback, constructive or just to let us know that you are enjoying the game!

With your help we have found some things we can improve upon, and are happy to report that we have addressed them in this update.


Content Update:
1. Updated each level to feel more populated and immersive, like a lived in world.


2. Powerup Visuals Update - Shield and Health powerups visual change and obtain animation.

3. Zahara Gameplay Adjustments - Increased Zahara's Damage per hit and increased the speed of her Health regeneration. 
	- Changed Wave Tear skill to create a lightning tornado Knock-up that starts off close range and travels to long range.

4. Enemy Health and damage Adjustments based on where you are in the game.
5. Improved Tutorial - As you encounter new Vile, Zahara will briefly message you to explain their abilities. This feedback will also be added to the Journal.
6. Spiral Tower Revamp - We have adjusted the enemies in the spiral tower. All 100 floors are now accessible!
7. Fixed issue with changing resolution.
8. Improved super armor interactions between the player and enemies.

Known Issues:
Due to ongoing issues related to the pandemic, our Japanese translations are still in progress. 
We are working to fix texture issues with levels 2 and 7.

notes.title: Upcoming Planet Zahur Flourishes Update
notes.notes:
We here at Zenith Edge studios want to thank everyone who has purchased Xenrai in Early Access, and a special thank you to everyone who has sent us feedback, constructive or just to let us know that you are enjoying the game! 

With your help we have found some things we can improve upon, and are happy to report that we have addressed them.

We have a large patch in the works and are doing some final tests.  The patch will be released Saturday morning the 29th of January 2022. Detailed patch notes will accompany it.   Detailed patch notes will accompany it.  Thank you for your patience with us as we are a two person team with one person handling coding.  Thank you again for your help during early access.  We hope that these improvements will continue to make Xenrai a more enjoyable and fulfilling gaming experience!

notes.title: December 26th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New and Improvements:
Added a monster Journal: This will give details about each monster and information on their mechanics. (Currently in English, Japanese coming soon).
Changed Wind Ride to be a toggle instead of a passive. Removed height cut off for the skill.

Modified or Changed:
Improved Vile super armor consistency.
Buffed Chaos wave to break through Infernal shield.
Buffed Burst Gauntlet to stagger enemies through super armor.
Lowered Wind ride sound effect base volume.
Updated lighting settings when playing on medium or low settings.
Lowered starting mouse sensitivity level.

Known Issues:
New Wind Ride toggle ability does not have an icon to inform that it is active.
Japanese translation for monster journal is missing.
These issues will be fixed next patch.
